title: Primary nav (≤5)
description: Ordered navigation with one primary 速览 tab; max five top-level views. Default spine: 速览 → 问题 → 设计 → 日路径 → 落地.
antiPatterns: competitors or full task DAG on overview by default
teaching dual wait / cursor read on day-1 overview
Play/Step/demo chrome without per-frame insight and structural change
acceptance matrix or L0–Ln backlog on the primary view
agentPrompt: Build a composition Canvas with ≤5 ordered Tabs: 速览 (primary), 问题, 设计, 日路径, 落地. Default is STATIC product design (BLUF + tables + ≤1 diagram). Do NOT add Play/Step demos unless the user explicitly needs a mechanism explainer with per-frame insight. Put acceptance and implementation phases on 落地 only. Start from templates/overview.canvas.tsx. See references/methodology.md Expression selection.
